policy.scope: Preserve all70 canonical WPs and four sprint acceptance scopes. These are execution rights, not new completion credits.

policy.already_reviewed: Preserve reviewed code and existing green evidence; do not manufacture red baseline or reimplement working modules.
policy.canonical_validation: disjoint-plan.py invokes existing delivery-ledger.py --check for all70IDs/four frozen scopes/dependencies.
policy.execution_dependency_rule: R1 is behavior-preserving extraction of source already composed at baseline; execution prerequisite is ancestor source commit, not promotion of canonical acceptance. No external flag, mint policy, live action, rollout or product dependency is satisfied by R1. Future feature/live dispatch must wait for a D0-resolved packet and actual hard prerequisites.
